Loops: for, for...of and for...in

for controls repetition explicitly; for...of iterates iterable values; for...in enumerates enumerable
string property keys, including inherited keys.
for loop එක index පාලනය කරනවා. for...of array එකක values ලබාJදනවා. for...in object keys
සඳහා Jයාදාගෙන්න පුළුවන්; inherited enumerable keys ද ලැබිය හැකියි.

Interview question: Why avoid for...in for array values?

Answer: It enumerates keys rather than values and can include additional enumerable
properties.
